opening.argument: The presentation promotes a BNB mining service through a referral link, directing viewers to connect a wallet and fund miners with BNB. It promises a three percent daily return and up to 1095% APR, while the displayed interface includes connected-wallet, miner balance, compounding, and withdrawal controls that encourage continued participation. The recurring compounding feature and referral pathway further support recruitment into the service. Although risk and no-guarantee disclaimers are included, the available evidence does not establish that any transaction, payout, loss, or wallet authorization occurred, or that the advertised returns were accurate.
